links.outcome: Readability of chatbot answers versus recommended level for target audience
links.effect: Readability scores (FRES, FKGL, GFI, SMOG) for all chatbots were above the recommended level for the target audience, although PEMAT-P understandability was acceptable (0.70-0.83).
links.quote: However, readability scores were above the recommended level for the target audience.

links.outcome: Reliability and verifiability of sources cited in chatbot responses
links.effect: Instances of low reliability or unverified sources were noted in chatbot responses, with no significant differences between the chatbots.
links.quote: Instances of low reliability or unverified sources were noted, with no significant differences between the chatbots.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of commercial LLM chatbots answering patient queries on premature ejaculation for readability, understandability, and reliability without testing a specific organizational deployment safeguard.
